_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 62: 13-16 April 2026. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He tells them to get serious for a minute, says they push on that and thanks God that Gabriel will not win, mentions France, and asks who the lady is because he does not want to name them wrongly.
mentions.quote: We thank you, Lord, that Gabriel will not win
mentions.falsify_match: The named French figure losing an election.
mentions.falsify_miss: They win. A named person and a binary outcome, which is checkable, though he is unsure of the names as he says them.

mentions.claim_text: He prays for change from the inside out and a clean heart, using the potter and clay image and asking to be moulded and searched, and says they want to go to the deep part of the river and the lake.
mentions.quote: Change from the inside out. Create me a clean heart
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a prayer of consecration, drawing on a familiar chorus.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says every decision Trump is about to make, that he sees the decisions and a major decision concerning Cuba, that he sees May, and that he sees people at a table and strategy.
mentions.quote: major decision concerning Cuba. I see people at a table
mentions.falsify_match: A major American decision on Cuba in May 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Fourth thing now hung on May, and the decision itself is not described.

mentions.claim_text: He speaks in tongues and says it is cold war, that things are attached from the cold war, mentions the panda and an angry figure, and says he sees Russia and the old iron curtain and the KGB, and August.
mentions.quote: it's cold war. I see Russia. I see the old iron curtain KGB
mentions.falsify_match: A Russian or Chinese escalation in August 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: A quiet August. The tongues section is described rather than transcribed.

mentions.claim_text: He reads that the key April dates often mentioned in occult calendars are April 19th through May 1st, a thirteen day period sometimes called the blood sacrifice time in some occult traditions, with April 19th cited as the high ritual day.
mentions.quote: April 19th through May 1st, a 13-day period
mentions.falsify_match: A significant violent event in that window.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing. The dates are read off a list rather than seen, which the mention records.

mentions.claim_text: He speaks of the Hitler spirit being fed by blood sacrifice from virgins and girls and says he saw them doing this in Berlin, then works through the dates, that Hitler was born on April the 20th of 1889 and died on April the 30th of 1945.
mentions.quote: the Hitler spirit by blood sacrifice from virgins. I saw them doing this in Berlin
mentions.falsify_match: Ritual killings in Berlin becoming public.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. An unevidenced accusation of ritual murder against unnamed people in a named city.

mentions.claim_text: They list the Columbine high school massacre in Colorado and the Oklahoma City bombing on April the 19th of 1995, and he asks how many times the Lord has warned them.
mentions.quote: Oklahoma City bombing on April the 19th of 1995
mentions.falsify_match: n/a: historical dates assembled to show a pattern.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: They add that the American Revolutionary War started on April 19th of 1775, and he says this is a very high alert week and that is what the Lord was showing him, and that he brings all this to them.
mentions.quote: This is a very high alert week
mentions.falsify_match: A significant attack in that week.
mentions.falsify_miss: A quiet week. The alert is built from historical anniversaries rather than from anything shown.

mentions.claim_text: They ask when the Tulsa massacre and the race riots there happened, wonder whether it is one of them, and establish that it was May 31st so it does not fit.
mentions.quote: When was the Tulsa massacre? No, that's May 31st
mentions.falsify_match: n/a. Worth recording: they test a date against the pattern, find it does not fit, and drop it.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says he has waited for this moment since July the 6th of 2014 when he went to the tribulation, that he told everybody to watch what happens, and speaks about this pope, saying the last one was too fat.
mentions.quote: I've waited for this moment since 2014 on July the 6th
mentions.falsify_match: A pope matching what he says he saw in 2014.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The 2014 sighting is outside this corpus, so only his description of it is available.

mentions.claim_text: He says that as they navigate through this they are in the last of the last days whether or not they want to acknowledge it, that the signs of the times are all around them, and begins to remind them of something from 2024.
mentions.quote: we are in the last of the last days
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and it forecloses disagreement in the same sentence: whether or not you acknowledge it.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: They work out which recording is meant, the one where he was sitting on the couch with Mama, and arrange to pull it up and play it.
mentions.quote: The one that I was sitting there with Mama on the couch
mentions.falsify_match: n/a: setting up another on-air replay.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says they can turn this thing and are turning it in prayer, turning it toward what he told them about the foundation for the new industrial revolution, and that he gave that word in February right after this.
mentions.quote: the foundation for the new industrial revolution
mentions.falsify_match: A technology shift described as a new industrial revolution, with the February telling in this corpus.
mentions.falsify_miss: The February telling does not say it.

mentions.claim_text: He says people tell him they do not believe it and that he does not care what they believe and it is fine if they do not, but asks that if they will not pray for the president why they are there in the first place other than as a troll.
mentions.quote: if you don't want to pray for him then why are you even here
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and it treats disagreement as trolling rather than as an objection to answer.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He asks about pride and says it opens the door to his front side, that pride enters into the man's heart and opens the door, that this is what the Lord said, and names pride and arrogance in those who like Jesus lay hands on people, calling it the fruit.
mentions.quote: Pride enters into the man's heart and opens the door
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a diagnosis of an unnamed minister's inner state.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says that is not a fair statement, that he has seen in part and heard in part concerning JD Vance and whether he will be president in 2028, and that he is praying for Rubio and for the next term if the Lord tarries.
mentions.quote: concerning J.D. Vance and concerning if he will be president in 2028
mentions.falsify_match: Vance becoming president in 2028.
mentions.falsify_miss: He does not. Notably softer than the January telling, which had him at the helm as a sight rather than a question.

mentions.claim_text: He speaks of going all the way and everything he has seen taking them into the shmita cycle, asks whether this timeframe is the one going into 2028 and 2029, says God he hopes so and that it would be wonderful, and allows that it may not be.
mentions.quote: is this one going into 2028 2029? God, I hope so
mentions.falsify_match: The cycle arriving in that window.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. He allows outright that it may not be, which is the honest framing.

mentions.claim_text: He says this is why he keeps telling them, that he knows he is seeing into the tribulation but does not know what year, asks whether this is 2028 or whether he is going past 2028, says he does not know, and notes many people tell him they have fifty or sixty years left.
mentions.quote: I know I'm seeing into the tribulation. I don't know when of what year
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and it is the clearest concession available: he does not know what year any of it belongs to.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He calls exceedingly abundantly above all they dare ask or think over their house, their marriages and their children, says their wayward children are coming home and they are calling them home, and calls in deliverance over their households.
mentions.quote: their wayward children are coming home. We're calling them home
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable in practice: any large audience supplies both outcomes.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He prays over Louisiana, Alabama, Mississippi and all the Gulf, praying a hedge around their refineries against every plot and plan and pursuit to kill, steal and destroy and to blow up their oil wells.
mentions.quote: We pray a hedge around and about our refineries
mentions.falsify_match: An attack on Gulf coast refinery infrastructure.
mentions.falsify_miss: None, credited to the prayer. Refineries are added to the water supply target from March.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is all connected and asks whether they see, that it is a spirit and there is something there, that he needs a little bit more, then yields to the Holy Spirit and prays at length in tongues.
mentions.quote: it's all connected. It's a spirit
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable. The tongues section is described rather than transcribed.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees the swastika on his arm, the mustache and the hair, prays further in tongues, and says it is the same thing that was attached to Oklahoma City and that he sees Timothy McVeigh.
mentions.quote: I see the swastika on his arm. I see the mustache
mentions.falsify_match: A domestic attack with far-right symbolism.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. It ties the Hitler spirit to the Oklahoma City bombing, which is the anniversary week they have just been discussing.

mentions.claim_text: He recalls what the Holy Spirit warned about President Trump, saying he spoke of the war and all these things, and that if the tariffs do not go into effect and they do not pray the Supreme Court justice to coincide with him then they are in the valley.
mentions.quote: when the tariffs don't go into effect and we don't pray the Supreme Court justice
mentions.falsify_match: Tariffs struck down and an adverse court ruling, followed by the consequences he named in December.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither. There is no plan B is now conditional on two specific outcomes, both of which are matters of record.
